$comment: Provenance anchor for the vendored LINE OpenAPI spec snapshots under openapi/. Records which upstream commit the committed specs correspond to and their LF-normalized content hashes. Consumed by scripts/check-spec-drift.ps1 (drift detection) and scripts/generate.ps1 -Update (pinned re-fetch). Upstream (github.com/line/line-openapi) publishes no tags/releases and its spec info.version fields are static, so the upstream commit SHA is the only reliable version anchor. See docs/LINE-dotnet-client-design.md §9.
hashNormalization: line endings normalized to LF before hashing

channel-access-token.yml.note: generate.ps1 quotes the unquoted urn: scheme inside a flow array (SharpYaml parse pitfall); the committed snapshot is already normalized, so this hash is of the normalized form.

module-attach.yml.note: Deliberately not imported (partner-only, manager.line.biz + Basic auth + form/PKCE). The sha256 is an awareness baseline only: drift detection reports upstream changes here but does not regenerate.
